evaluation_protocol: Shuffle unique protein IDs in a NumPy object array with RandomState(42); assign the first 80% of IDs to training and the rest to testing; retain a pair only when both proteins belong to the same partition; exclude cross-partition pairs; fit on retained training pairs and evaluate on retained testing pairs.
